evidence: Tungsten hexacarbonyl [W(CO)6] was used as precursor while H2S plasma served the purpose of the reactant. High purity Ar gas of 200 SCCM was used as a purging gas. To achieve a better vapor pressure and smooth transfer of the precursor, it was heated at 40 /C14 C during the reaction and an overhead 50 SCCM Ar gas was used as carrier gas.
